meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘并推送数据快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NanoClaw 并需要可视化运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard and push data snapshots to NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and need to visualize its runtime status

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会给 NanoClaw 加监控面板：安装 npm 包、复制推送器文件、在 src/index.ts 插入启动代码、配置环境变量并构建。随后 3100 端口出现面板，展示会话、用户、Token 用量和实时日志。
howto.when: 当用户要求给 NanoClaw 添加监控面板、仪表盘或实时日志查看功能时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上监控面板。
say.note: 会安装依赖并完成代码接线。

say.text: 生成 DASHBOARD_SECRET 并启动面板。
say.note: 会写入 .env 并重建服务。

say.text: 帮 NanoClaw 装个带实时日志的仪表盘。

howto.what_en: Claude installs the npm package, copies pusher files, wires startup code into src/index.ts, adds env vars, and builds. A dashboard appears on localhost:3100 showing sessions, users, token usage, and real-time logs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a monitoring dashboard, metrics panel, or real-time log viewer to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Installs dependencies and wires the code.

say_en.text: Generate DASHBOARD_SECRET and start the dashboard.
Install a dashboard with real-time logs for NanoClaw.
